# Compliance

#### Simplify compliance with Bizagi

Bizagi cloud makes it easy to maintain compliance with increasingly demanding local and global regulations.

![Silhouette icons linked by lines](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/Contextualization.png)

##### ISO 27001

## ![ISO-27001-logo.png](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/ISO-27001-logo.png)

## **ISO 27001**

Bizagi is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified. Bizagi's information security Management System (ISMS) is based on ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standard.

##### FedRAMP

![FedRAMP logo](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/FEDRAMP-logo.png)

## **FedRAMP**

Bizagi Cloud for US Government is compliant with the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) at the Moderate Level. Details can be found on the [FedRAMP Marketplace.](https://marketplace.fedramp.gov/#!/product/bizagi-cloud-for-us-government?sort=productName)

##### HIPAA

## ![Independent reviews have concluded that Bizagi Cloud meets the requirements of the HIPAA/HITECH regulations.](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/HIPAA-logo.png)

## **HIPAA**

Independent reviews have concluded that Bizagi Cloud meets the requirements of the HIPAA/HITECH regulations.

##### GDPR

![Bizagi is committed to providing the features to achieve GDPR compliance and enforce privacy and protection of personal data. ](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/GDPR-logo.png)

## **GDPR**

Bizagi is committed to providing the features to achieve GDPR compliance and enforce privacy and protection of personal data. For more information please refer to [GDPR compliance with Bizagi.](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/gdpr_compliance_bizagi_portals.htm)

##### Annual Transparency Report

## ![ISO-27001-logo.png](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Icons/file-search-48.svg)

## **Annual Transparency Report**

Bizagi's [Annual Transparency Report](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/PDFs/Bizagi_Annual_Transparency_Report.pdf) provides details of all government requests for customer data.
